units.source_text: [\[23\]](#part1335.html#w23) 平仲是一个有名的好色男子。

en.t: [23] Taira no Nakahira was a well-known amorous man.

units.source_text: 他要在女人面前装假哭，蘸些水涂在眼睛上，误蘸了墨水。

en.t: When he tried to pretend to cry in front of a woman, he dipped something in water to smear on his eyes, but by mistake he dipped it in ink.
The story appears in Konjaku Monogatari.
